themepack_card_desc: suav nrog cov ntsiab lus zoo nkauj hauv zej zog, cov ntsiab lus daws teeb meem siab, thiab cov ntawv sau tau tsim tshwj xeeb rau cov duab 360p.
themepack_installed_success: ✓ 360p Ntsiab Pob tau teeb tsa ua tiav!
themepack_step1_title: Kauj ruam 1: Txuas hauv USB Cia Hom
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Qhib koj tus neeg uas ua ntawv los ntawm tuav lub Hwj chim khawm.
2. Thaum Rockbox khau raj, ntsaws lub USB cable rau hauv koj lub computer.
3. Yog hais tias prompted ntawm tus neeg uas ua ntawv screen, paub meej tias USB Storage hom kom lub ntaus ntawv zoo li ib tug tsav.
themepack_step2_title: Kauj ruam 2: Xaiv Ib Folder ntawm tus neeg uas ua ntawv
themepack_step2_desc: Vim hais tias kev khiav hauj lwm systems (xws li macOS) nkaum dotfiles (xws li .rockbox) los ntawm lub neej ntawd, koj tuaj yeem xaiv ib qho nplaub tshev lossis lub hauv paus tsav ntawm koj tus neeg ua si. Peb yuav pom lossis tsim .rockbox phau ntawv qhia rau koj.
themepack_status_extracting: Txhim kho cov ntsiab lus rau hauv .rockbox...
themepack_complete: Ntsiab lus pob tiav ntsia! Tam sim no koj tuaj yeem tshem tawm koj cov neeg ua si yam tsis muaj kev cuam tshuam thiab xaiv lub ntsiab lus hauv Rockbox (Chaw> Cov Ntsiab Lus).
themepack_err_not_found: Tsis tuaj yeem nrhiav lossis pib lub .rockbox directory ntawm tus tsav xaiv. Thov xyuas kom meej tias koj tau xaiv ib daim nplaub tshev ntawm koj lub player.
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Hla mus rau USB Storage Hom
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Kauj ruam 1: Restart tus neeg uas ua ntawv thiab reconnect
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Disconnect tus USB cable.
2. Fais fab tus neeg uas ua ntawv rov qab rau thiab cia nws khau raj rau hauv Rockbox.
3. Thaum Rockbox khiav, rov txuas USB cable, ces nias Txuas ntxiv.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Kauj ruam 2: Nrhiav tus neeg uas ua ntawv tshaj ADB ...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Lub app tab tom saib rau ADB kev sib txuas (txog 30 vib nas this). Yog tias pom ib lub cuab yeej, cov ntsiab lus raug xa mus thiab cov neeg uas ua ntawv rebooted txiav. Txwv tsis pub, hla ua ntej mus rau USB Storage Hom.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Tos rau ADB ntaus ntawv... (txog 30 vib nas this)
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: Ntaus tau pom ({serial}); hloov cov ntsiab lus ...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Tsis muaj ADB ntaus ntawv kuaj pom hauv 30 vib nas this; txuas ntxiv nrog USB Storage Hom.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Tsis muaj ADB binary muaj rau lub app; txuas ntxiv nrog USB Storage Hom.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Pushing themes thiab fonts hla ADB ...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB hloov tsis tau; poob rov qab mus rau USB Storage hom
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Qhib USB Cia Hom ntawm tus neeg uas ua ntawv kom nws zoo li lub tsav.
2. Xaiv ib qho nplaub tshev ntawm cov neeg uas ua ntawv hauv qab no (.rockbox, Suab paj nruag, Ntsiab lus, lossis lub hauv paus tsav - qhov zais .rockbox nplaub tshev nyob rau hauv).
3. Lub app sib koom ua ke cov ntsiab lus 360p thiab fonts hauv, sau cov ntaub ntawv tib lub npe.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Tam sim no koj tuaj yeem tshem tawm cov neeg ua si yam tsis muaj kev cuam tshuam thiab xaiv lub ntsiab lus hauv Rockbox (Chaw> Cov Ntsiab Lus).
legacy_cleanup_desc: Ib tug laus version ntawm Updater yog tseem nyob rau hauv lub computer no thiab yuav siv sij hawm qhov chaw disk. Uninstalling nws frees qhov chaw.
legacy_cleanup_reclaim: Reclaims kwv yees li {size} ntawm qhov chaw disk
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Tshem tawm daim ntawv thov Innioasis Updater qub thiab txhawb cov folders
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Khaws Android Platform cuab yeej (ADB / Fastboot) ntsia
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Yog tias koj tsis siv ADB lossis Fastboot sab nraud Updater CE, tshem tawm kom tshem tawm thiab rov qab khaws cia ntxiv.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Ua tau zoo ntxuav cov cuab yeej cuab tam thiab rov qab qhov chaw disk.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Ib qho qub version ntawm Updater tseem nyob hauv lub computer no. Uninstalling nws frees qhov chaw disk.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Qhov no tshem tawm cov qub app thiab nws cov ntaub ntawv txhawb nqa. Downloaded firmware yog khaws cia.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Tshem tawm cov cuab yeej hauv Platform (ADB / Fastboot) thiab? Xaiv Keep yog tias koj siv ADB.
